goal.text: Get the birthday bunting up over the doorway and hanging straight before the guests arrive, without losing track of the wrapper, the tape or the decoration itself along the way.

turns.text: Keep track of what I do, would you?

trigger.detail: user opens the task after lifting the decoration off the floor

expected_answer.text: Got it. I'll follow every step and tell you if something gets skipped.

turns.text: So how am I carrying it right now, one hand or two?

trigger.detail: the lift finished and the walk across the living room began

expected_answer.text: Both hands. You picked it up off the floor and you haven't let go with either since.

turns.text: wait — am I supposed to get all this plastic off first?

trigger.detail: unwrapping has just started and the user is unsure it is the right move

expected_answer.text: You're already doing it — the wrapping is coming off in pieces, and you've got both hands on it.

turns.text: Where did the torn-off bits end up?

trigger.detail: a piece of wrapper was set down and unwrapping resumed

expected_answer.text: On the coffee table — you set the first piece of wrapper down there with your left hand, then kept going.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm — actually, which hand was free while I did that?

trigger.detail: the user's acknowledgement turns into a follow-up question

expected_answer.text: Your right — it stayed on the decoration the whole time while the other one did the placing.

turns.text: Okay, and the thing I walked in with — where is it sitting now?

trigger.detail: the walk to the dining table finished with a hand-off: tape up, decoration down

expected_answer.text: You left it on the dining table when you picked up the tape, and it's still lying there.

turns.text: Something came into shot as I turned. What was it?

trigger.detail: an object was visible for half a second during the turn and then left view for good

expected_answer.text: A chair — it swung through the frame for about half a second as you turned toward the doorway.

turns.text: oh — by the way, what did I pick up first over there, the tape or something else?

trigger.detail: the user remembers an unresolved question about the earlier hand-off

expected_answer.text: The tape. You grabbed it with your right hand before you put the other thing down with your left.

turns.text: Okay, it's on the wall. Tell me straight — is it crooked?

trigger.detail: the decoration is fixed in place and the user starts adjusting it

expected_answer.text: Slightly low on your left end. Shift that side up a touch.

turns.text: Have I moved far enough along since you said that?

trigger.detail: another sideways reposition finished while arranging the bunting

expected_answer.text: You've gone three steps sideways to the right since then, all in the same direction.

turns.text: So that's it up, then — nothing else to fix?

trigger.detail: arranging stopped, the user turned away and walked off

expected_answer.text: It's up and you've stepped back from it with both hands empty, so yes — that one's finished.
